svg.title: Plague-Bot VR
svg.desc: Project file 01: Plague-Bot VR, Dec 2025 – Jun 2026. JADA Robotics · Team captain and technical lead. Autonomous robot for early pest detection in tomato greenhouses, teleoperated in VR. 20 ha: Validated in a commercial greenhouse, Oaxaca. 40–60 ms: Teleoperation latency, measured over 4G. 18 FPS: Video to the headset over 4G, in the field.
